text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Inari One and Tamamo Cross
stopping by the side of the central plaza...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Horseshoes and textbooks?
What in the world is all this stuff doing here?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ain't it a flea market?
It's all lined up real neat and tidy, see.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like... please take them...
I can't win any races, so...
I don't need them anymore...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ho~ don't need 'em, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hold yer horses, don't go jumpin' the gun!
Keep 'em till ya feel like runnin' again, alright?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Tama, throwin' cold water on someone is in bad taste.
Let's hear her out and take her at her word.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho? Is that a photo from a race over there?
You givin' that away too?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a photo? Was that in there...?
Maybe it got mixed up in my things...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
This is... from my very first win.
Why is it here...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Look at that great smile on yer face!
I knew it... ya still love runnin'—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here! Keepin' a thing like this around
is just gonna hold ya back with regrets!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna toss it straight in the trash for ya!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, huh!?
Pl-Pl-Please wait...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hold up, Inari~! Give the girl her photo back!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No dice! My mind's made up—it's gettin' chucked!
If ya want it back, come and catch me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Tag, you're it! Follow the clappin' hands~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That idiot Inari really means to trash it!
Are ya just gonna let her do that!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Put quite a bit of distance between us.
...Did she give up, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Haha, well look at that! You're so red-hot
you'd put a boiled octopus to shame!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now things are gettin' interesting!
Let's have ourselves a good ol' brawl!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaah... ah... ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Desperately trying to take back the photo, the horse girl
closed in on Inari One... and came to a halt right before her.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Why... Why!
I already decided... to quit...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...How're ya feelin' right now, kid?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to catch up... I was frustrated...
Frustrated, so frustrated...!
............I WANNA WIIINNN!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Look at that, you can say it after all.
That voice from the bottom of your heart, I heard it loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm real glad yer runnin' again!
Ya did good too, Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The hard part starts now. It's a thorny path
where you'll push yourself till your tears run dry.
Once you push through all that, come pick a fight with me again!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Case closed, just like that!
